Tests that on_request hook can reject a request

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

do {
    let _request = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\"}")
    _ = try await LiterLlm.chat(request: _request)
} catch {
    let _errorMessage = String(describing: error)
    let _errorType = String(describing: type(of: error))
    XCTAssertTrue(_errorMessage.contains("HookRejected") || _errorType.contains("HookRejected"), "expected error to mention \"HookRejected\", got message: \(_errorMessage), type: \(_errorType)")
}
```
